questions.stem: Translate the following into English: 今天是十月三十日，星期五。现在上午九点十五分。
markscheme: B1: today is Friday, 30 October (correct day, date and month)
B1: it is now 9:15 in the morning
questions.modelAnswer: 今天是十月三十日，星期五。= 'Today is Friday, 30 October.' Chinese dates run from the larger unit to the smaller one: 十月 (October), 三十日 (the thirtieth). 现在上午九点十五分。= 'It is now 9:15 in the morning.' 上午 specifies a.m., and 十五分 is fifteen minutes past the hour.

questions.stem: Translate the following into English: 蔡伦改进了造纸术。毕昇发明了活字印刷。
markscheme: B1: Cai Lun improved papermaking
B1: Bi Sheng invented movable-type printing
questions.modelAnswer: 蔡伦改进了造纸术。= 'Cai Lun improved papermaking.' 改进 means to improve an existing method, so 'invented paper' would be inaccurate. 毕昇发明了活字印刷。= 'Bi Sheng invented movable-type printing.' 活字 refers to individual reusable characters, and 发明 is to invent.

questions.stem: In Li Bai's 《静夜思》, the speaker first raises his head and then lowers it. What does he look at, and what feeling do these actions express?
markscheme: B1: he looks at the bright moon (举头望明月)
B1: he misses his hometown / expresses homesickness (低头思故乡)
questions.modelAnswer: In 举头望明月, the speaker raises his head to look at the bright moon. In 低头思故乡, he lowers his head and thinks of his hometown. The simple change from looking up to looking down expresses quiet homesickness; the moon is the image that prompts the feeling.

questions.stem:
Read the sentence and answer in English.

清晨，湖面像一面明亮的镜子。微风轻轻梳理着岸边的柳枝。

(a) Name the rhetorical device in 湖面像一面明亮的镜子 and explain its effect. (b) Which phrase gives the breeze a human action?
markscheme: B1: (a) simile / metaphor (比喻), introduced by 像
B1: it vividly suggests that the lake is smooth, still and bright like a mirror
B1: (b) 梳理着 (combing) — the breeze is described as combing the willow branches
questions.modelAnswer: (a) The comparison 湖面像一面明亮的镜子 uses 比喻, specifically a simile marked by 像 ('like'). Comparing the lake with a bright mirror makes its smooth, reflective surface easy to picture. (b) 微风轻轻梳理着岸边的柳枝 gives the breeze the human action of combing hair: 梳理着 ('combing'). This is personification (拟人).

questions.stem:
Use this passage to answer all three parts in English.

北宋时期，毕昇把一个个字做成可以重复使用的活字。印书时，人们先按文章内容拼好版面，用完以后还能把字拆下来重新排列。与每次都要刻整块木板的雕版印刷相比，这种方法节省了时间和材料，也让知识传播得更快。

(a) What could people do with the movable characters after printing? (b) How was woodblock printing different? (c) Give two benefits of Bi Sheng's method stated in the passage.
markscheme: B1: (a) they could take the characters apart and rearrange / reuse them for another page
B1: (b) a whole wooden block had to be carved each time
B1: (c) it saved time and materials AND helped knowledge spread faster (both benefits required)
questions.modelAnswer: (a) After printing, people could dismantle the page and rearrange the same movable characters for reuse (把字拆下来重新排列). (b) Woodblock printing required a whole block to be carved for each page (每次都要刻整块木板). (c) Bi Sheng's method saved both time and materials, and it allowed knowledge to spread more quickly (节省了时间和材料，也让知识传播得更快).

questions.stem:
Render this conversation in simplified Chinese.
A: Excuse me, how can I get to the library?
B: Go straight ahead, then turn left. The library is on the right of the park.
markscheme: B1: 请问，去图书馆怎么走？ and 往前走，然后往左拐 (or equivalent correct directions)
B1: 图书馆在公园的右边。— A 在 B 的右边 used correctly
questions.modelAnswer: A: 请问，去图书馆怎么走？(Qǐngwèn, qù túshūguǎn zěnme zǒu?) — 怎么走 asks how to get somewhere. B: 往前走，然后往左拐。图书馆在公园的右边。(Wǎng qián zǒu, ránhòu wǎng zuǒ guǎi. Túshūguǎn zài gōngyuán de yòubiān.) — 然后 sequences the directions, and A 在 B 的右边 means A is on B's right.

questions.stem: Write 3–5 sentences in Chinese about a festival you enjoy. You must include: one thing you do with other people; one food associated with the celebration; and why you enjoy the festival.
markscheme: B1: names a festival and describes a shared activity with an appropriate verb
B1: names a relevant festival food correctly
B1: gives a clear reason for enjoying it, appropriately introduced by 因为 or an equivalent structure
questions.modelAnswer: Example answer: 我最喜欢中秋节。晚上，我和家人一起赏月。我们一边吃月饼，一边聊天。我喜欢中秋节，因为全家人可以开心地团聚。(I like the Mid-Autumn Festival best. In the evening, I admire the moon with my family. We eat mooncakes while chatting. I like it because the whole family can happily reunite.) Other accurate, relevant festival answers are equally valid.

questions.stem: In Meng Haoran's 《春晓》, the speaker hears birds at dawn and remembers the night's wind and rain. Explain how these sounds help create two different feelings about spring.
markscheme: B1: birdsong everywhere suggests the freshness and joy of a spring morning
B1: remembering wind and rain leads to concern that many flowers have fallen
B1: the contrast combines delight in spring with regret at its passing / damage to its beauty
questions.modelAnswer: 处处闻啼鸟 fills the spring morning with birdsong, creating a lively, joyful atmosphere and showing the speaker's delight in spring. Remembering 夜来风雨声 leads to 花落知多少: the speaker wonders how many flowers were blown down, which introduces regret and concern. Together the sounds connect 喜春 (joy in spring) with 惜春 (regret that spring's beauty is passing).
